meta.title: Fix CodeRabbit feedback on Query Node implementation
meta.body_summary: Address CodeRabbit feedback on Query Node by adding input validation, type safety improvements, DB query optimization, and error handling across multiple packages.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot addressed CodeRabbit feedback with validation, query optimization, and tests, but maintainer removed an over-mocked test and closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 586 changed lines across 9 files, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume. It was closed without merge, as the maintainer removed an over-mocked test and the PR did not progress to merge.

review_details.concern_detail: The maintainer satococoa removed the query-github-vector-store.test.ts file in a commit titled 'Remove over-mocking test', then closed the PR without merge. No formal review text was provided.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved performance by combining two database queries into one, and enhanced input validation and error handling.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer explicitly removed an over-mocked test and closed the PR, suggesting the test approach was unacceptable and no further action was taken.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent implemented CodeRabbit feedback fixes including query optimization, but wrote an over-mocked test that the maintainer discarded; this indicates a gap in test design aligned with project standards.

detection_detail.code_reading: Likely the maintainer reviewed test code and found it over-mocked.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling evidence; PR closed without performance validation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer removed the problematic test and closed the PR without merging; no further iteration.

core_change_summary.description: Added input validation in rag query, renamed type to avoid conflict, optimized DB query from two separate queries to a single join, added error handling, and added tests which were later removed.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The primary test file for the vector store was added and then removed due to over-mocking; other test files remain.
change_trajectory: Main implementation commit (059248a): added validation, query optimization, type safety, error handling, and tests.
Maintainer commit (c9a58ca): removed over-mocked test file and closed PR.
